title_zh: 社会服务与人际沟通 — 第21节
body_en: Service talk is a useful life skill: greet, state the problem, offer options, thank. Practice with role play in class. Calm words lower heat in hard talks with shops or offices. Clear speech saves time for everyone.
body_zh: 服务话术也是生活技能：问候、说明问题、给出选项、感谢。课上用角色扮演练。冷静措辞能给商店或办公室里的难谈降温。清楚表达为人人省时间。
